title: ASUS Vivobook 14 Flip (TP3407)
shortDescription: 360-degree convertible 14-inch laptop with a touch display and Intel Core Ultra processors.
description:
Vivobook 14 Flip has a 360-degree hinge, so it works as a laptop, tent, stand or tablet, with a touch display and stylus support.

It runs Intel Core Ultra processors and comes in Matte Gray.

Processor: Intel Core Ultra 9 Processor 386H 2.1 GHz (18MB Cache, up to 4.9 GHz, 16 cores, 16 Threads); Intel NPU up to 50TOPS
Intel Core Ultra 7 Processor 355 2.3 GHz (12MB Cache, up to 4.7 GHz, 8 cores, 8 Threads); Intel NPU up to 49TOPS
Intel Core Ultra 7 Processor 258V 32GB 2.2 GHz (12MB Cache, up to 4.8 GHz, 8 cores, 8 Threads); Intel AI Boost NPU up to 47TOPS
Intel Core Ultra 7 Processor 256V 16GB 2.2 GHz (12MB Cache, up to 4.8 GHz, 8 cores, 8 Threads); Intel AI Boost NPU up to 47TOPS
Intel Core Ultra 5 Processor 226V 16GB 2.1 GHz (8MB Cache, up to 4.5 GHz, 8 cores, 8 Threads); Intel AI Boost NPU up to 40TOPS
Neural Processor: Intel AI Boost NPU up to 49TOPS
Intel AI Boost NPU up to 40TOPS

Display: 35.56cm (14), FHD+ (1920 x 1200) OLED 16:10 aspect ratio, 0.2ms response time, Refresh Rate:60Hz refresh rate, 500nits HDR peak brightness, 100% DCI-P3 color gamut, 1,000,000:1, VESA CERTIFIED Display HDR True Black 500, 1.07 billion colors, 70% less harmful blue light
65% less harmful blue light, TÜV Rheinland-certified, Touch screen, - (Screen-to-body ratio)85%, With stylus support, 300nits

Storage: 1TB M.2 NVMe PCIe 4.0 SSD + 100GB Cloud Storage with Microsoft 365 Basic for 1 Year*.
512GB M.2 NVMe PCIe 4.0 SSD + 100GB Cloud Storage with Microsoft 365 Basic for 1 Year*.

I/O Ports: 1x Thunderbolt 4 with support for display / power delivery (data speed up to 40Gbps)
1x USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C with support for display / power delivery (data speed up to 20Gbps)
1x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A, 1x 3.5mm Combo Audio Jack
1x HDMI 2.1 TMDS, Micro SD card reader

Input.Keyboard & Touchpad: Backlit Chiclet Keyboard, 1.7mm Key-travel, Precision touchpad, With Copilot key
Input.Camera: FHD camera with IR function to support Windows Hello, With privacy shutter

Power Supply: TYPE-C, 65W AC Adapter, Output: 20V DC, 3.25A, 65W, Input: 100-240V AC 50/60Hz universal

TYPE-C, 68W AC Adapter, Output: 20V DC, 3.4A, 68W, Input: 100~240V AC 50/60Hz universal, *Whether a charger is included varies according to country, region and model. Please check with your local ASUS retailer for details.

Operating System: Windows 11 Home - ASUS recommends Windows 11 Pro for business, *Windows 11 Home is available only as the Single Language edition in selected markets. Learn more about Windows 11 Home Single language: https://support.microsoft.com/article/eaf060a6-3642-4612-6b75-b34e57a08abf, No preinstalled OS

Security: BIOS Booting User Password Protection, IR webcam with Windows Hello support

ASUS's spec sheet lists every configuration sold worldwide (multi-value fields are the available options), and asus.com/in publishes only a 'starting at' price, so each colour is one variant at that price. Per-configuration India prices are on in.store.asus.com, which blocks automated access.
